heroLead: Installation guides, user manuals and technical reference for Didactika plugins and libraries, available for every supported version and in several languages.

orgStartText: Install the plugin, give people the permission it needs and complete a first task in minutes.

versionsText: Each plugin has one documentation for every line of Moodle it supports. A newer line keeps what it shares with the older one and changes only what differs, and the version selector of the header moves you between them.
